title: a forward `:>` leaves no stale unresolved-reference warning
note: FIXED 2026-09-03 (I4). The specialization DID bind, but the warning was written at the declaration before resolution had happened and only the `:` typing path ever retracted one — so `--strict` failed a perfectly valid file. Warnings are emitted AFTER resolution now, so only a genuinely unresolvable name gets one (see L3-unresolved-specialization, the negative control).
